Removing it, or a new recovery sheet, locks it out of the current suite, and GhulDrive and your servers get new keys: an old copy of the suite file no longer reaches them. Such a copy still opens with what you lost, though, and shows the state of back then, including the logins of your mail accounts. So also change your mail passwords with each provider and enter them in GhulSuite again.

The GhulSuite server module is one PHP file on your website. It is only needed for share links: it hands them out and ends them after the expiry or the last download. The app installs it over this server’s login.

Choose the folder your website is delivered from, e.g. public_html. Only the module goes in there, as ghulsuite.php; your GhulSuite folder stays outside the website, and the module reads it on the server.
Leave it empty: the app tries the usual addresses.
The server module runs at %1$s. You can now create share links.
GhulSuite folder not reachable from the web
No answer at %1$s. Enter the address of the module above and try again.
PHP does not run there: the web server delivered the file as text. The app removed it again. The module cannot work on this web hosting.
PHP may read the GhulSuite folder but not write in its shares folder. Then downloads cannot be counted. Allow the web server to write there (file permissions), then check again.
The web server hands out the GhulSuite folder itself (%1$s). The app removed the module again. Move the GhulSuite folder out of the website, then install again.
PHP may not read the GhulSuite folder on this hosting (e.g. because of open_basedir). Share links are not possible there.
Share links of this server stop working at once. Your files stay.
Server module: not installed (only needed for share links)
Server module: version %1$s, version %2$s is available
Needs the GhulSuite server module. Tap to install it.
Share links come from GhulDrive’s server. Set up GhulDrive first.
The recipient gets every file on its own.
The key of the GhulDrive file is missing.
The server module does not answer.
Share links need the GhulSuite server module.

plurals.item: %1$s is no longer at the provider.
%1$s are no longer at the provider.

Automatic archive: %1$s mails copied to GhulDrive.

resources.string: The mail archive keeps its copies in GhulDrive. Set up GhulDrive first, then archive.
Copies go to GhulDrive, encrypted, into the folder “Mail-Archiv”. The mails stay at your provider as they are; delete them there yourself if you like. Mails already in the archive are skipped.
All mails in “%1$s” older than %2$s are copied.
Archiving copies mails into GhulDrive. Nothing changes at your provider.
Copies of your mails in GhulDrive, by year. What you do here does not touch your provider.
Cannot be read as a mail.
It goes to GhulDrive\'s trash. The mail at your provider stays as it is.
Copies mails of the inbox and Sent into GhulDrive, once a day after unlocking. Nothing is deleted at your provider. The same on all your devices.
The archive needs GhulDrive. Set it up to switch this on.
Connection works. You can save the account now.
Server not found. Check the server name.
The server refused the connection. Check the port and the security setting.
No answer from the server in time. Check server name, port and your internet connection.
Login rejected. Check login name and password (some providers need an app password).
Connection works, the folder can be written. You can save the server now.
GhulDrive can use several servers. Each storage location has its own files and its own share links; GhulDrive always shows the active one. The logins are stored encrypted in the Drive file.
No storage location yet. Add a server where GhulDrive keeps its files.
Storage location added. The active one stays; switch in GhulDrive with "Switch storage location".
The storage location disappears from GhulDrive on all devices. All share links of this location end.
Also delete the files on the server
The encrypted files stay on the server. If you add the same folder again later, they are back.
GhulDrive deletes its files in this folder on the server, the server module as well. This cannot be undone.
Each storage location has its own files. Switching changes what GhulDrive shows; nothing is copied.
Archived mails always go to this GhulDrive storage location, also while GhulDrive shows another one.
The archive is on the storage location %1$s. GhulDrive shows another one right now. Switch to %1$s to see the archive.
Another storage location or server still uses this folder. Its files are therefore not deleted; remove the location without the tick.

The share links of this location could not be ended. If you remove it anyway, GhulSuite only forgets the links; they keep working as long as the server hands them out. Nothing is deleted on the server.
A key change is running. The files there keep the earlier key, which is deleted after the change: if you add the folder again later, they can no longer be opened.
There are changes that are not in the suite file yet. Save them before you go on working on another device.
Everything is saved in the suite file.
Not saved as a file yet.

The suite file (.ghlzip) holds all vaults, encrypted and sealed. Take it to another device, e.g. on a USB stick, and open it there. Nothing is matched: the state saved last is the current one. GhulDrive lives on your server and is the same everywhere.
The suite file cannot be reached right now (is the USB stick plugged in?). Save to a new place or try again.
The suite file could not be written. The file there is unchanged.
The file was saved somewhere else meanwhile. Overwrite it (the changes from there are lost) or save under a new name?
There is another suite or no GhulSuite file at this place. Overwrite it or save under a new name?
%1$s is checked completely first. Only then it replaces the state on this device.
Forgot the password? Open with the recovery code
Emergency: the code opens the file without the password. Its seal cannot be checked then. Afterwards a new master password protects the suite.
This file holds another suite than the one on this device. It replaces everything here.
This file is older than your state here.
This file was carried on from another state than yours here.
This device has changes that are in no suite file yet. They are lost. Save first if you want to keep them. GhulDrive files, share links and sent mails are on the server and stay.
Opened with the recovery code: without the password it could not be checked that the file is unchanged.
Parts of the suite file do not match its list: it was changed or is damaged.
A newer state was built meanwhile. Please save again.
%1$s is a %2$s vault. What would you like to do?
Only this vault is unlocked, your suite stays locked. Changes go straight back into this file.
GhulDrive and GhulMail vaults need the servers and accounts of a suite. They can only be added to one.
After you unlock your suite, the vault is added to it and gets the protection of your suite.
Start a new suite with it
%1$s (%2$s). Enter the password of the vault and its key or key file.
Open on its own: %1$s from %2$s. Your suite stays locked. Every change is written back into this file.
Writing the changes into the file …
The file could not be written (is the storage still there?). Your changes are still here.
Closing or locking ends it; changes not yet written go into the file first.
Second factor of the new vault:
To confirm: your own master password.
Last step: save the vault file.
Now save the new key file. Hand it over separately from the vault file.
The recovery code of the new vault. It opens the vault without password and key: hand it over separately or keep it safe. It is shown only now.
After unlocking, %1$s is added to your suite.
Choose either a new key file or a security key.
No vault is open on its own.
Only GhulPass and GhulAuth entries can be handed on as a vault.
This vault can only be added to a suite.
The app may not write into this file (e.g. a mail attachment). Save it somewhere else first, or add the vault to your suite.
Done. Hand on the vault file, the key file and the password separately.
The last changes to %1$s could not be written into its file (was the storage gone, or the app ended?). Write them now, or give them up.
Still not written. Is the storage there? Try again later.
Not while a vault is open on its own.
A vault of the suite cannot be read (Options > Vaults). Remove it or bring it back, then save.
The file was changed elsewhere since it was opened. Overwrite it with this vault, or save this vault as a new file.
The file was changed elsewhere meanwhile: writing would overwrite that. Save as a new file instead if unsure.
The last changes to %1$s are lost; the file stays as it is.
%1$s was changed since or cannot be read (was writing it cut off?). Giving up may lose this vault. Better save it as a new file.
Changes of the last opening still wait for this file. Write them first (or give them up).
The vault is still being written into its file. Try again in a moment.
Changes of a vault opened on its own are left, but which file they belong to is unreadable. Save them as a new file, or give them up.
The file is gone or cannot be read (moved, deleted, storage away?). Write it anew there, or save as a new file.
The file is not there or cannot be read now. Writing creates it anew.
These changes are lost; which file they belonged to is unknown.
The file is gone or cannot be read (moved, deleted, storage away?). It is written as soon as it is back; else save the vault as a new file.
%1$s is not there now. If it is really gone, giving up loses this vault. Better save it as a new file.
The file is not there or cannot be read now. Is the storage back? Then try again; otherwise save as a new file.
Still not there. Is the storage back? Otherwise save as a new file.

The protection of your suite was changed. So that older copies of the suite file no longer reach your servers, the suite has a new SSH key. On these servers the hoster manages keys in its web panel, which only works there:
Add the new key (below) in the hoster's web panel, then tap “Check”.
The new key works. Now remove the old key in the hoster's web panel, then tap “Check”.
Not reached yet, tried again later.

The protection of your suite was changed. Save the suite file now and replace older copies on other devices, sticks or in backups with it. They still open with the old protection, but no longer reach GhulDrive and your servers.
